The '''G'uotr Network''' was a [[Black market/Legends|black market]] that formed on [[D'larah]] during the panic surrounding an imminent [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] in the [[Demophon system/Legends|Demophon system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It made fantastic profits selling goods no longer available in the city, and despite their best efforts the [[D'larah City Patrol]] could neither stop them nor discover the identity of their leader [[Elena Ray]]. In addition to rare luxuries the Network also arranged for evacuations off planet, for a price. They often used [[Marqo's]] as a meeting place due to their arrangement with proprietor [[Cradjius Lucern]].<ref name="TC" />
